Designated Employers

Home / Designated Employers

En Francaise

Below is a list of designated local employers in Sault Ste. Marie is participating in the Rural and Community Immigration Pilot (RCIP). Please note that not all employers listed are currently hiring, and many are receiving a high volume of inquiries. Important: You should never pay anyone for a job offer or employment in Canada. For more information, please visit the IRCC website on fraud protection.

 

Please note that the designation of employers does not mean they are guaranteed allocations under the pilot. Employers only need to be designated once. Only employers in the Selected Sectors can send in applications for 2026.
